summary: Fresh public-endpoint verification completed for backend and frontend. Backend pytest exercised 30 catalogue, auth/lockout, notify, product CRUD, simulated order, credentials, chat, status, authorization, persistence, and redaction cases: 26 passed and 4 deterministic failures reproduced on retry. Playwright covered desktop/mobile landing, rotating hero, both products, quick view, monthly/annual/shared modal flows, simulated preplanned/recharge purchases, private order page, credentials, buyer/admin chat, status update, admin login, full product CRUD, coming-soon notify capture, and notify listing. Core end-to-end flows work, with two reproduced UI defects and validation/security gaps.

critical.issue: Brute-force lockout reaches 429 after the fifth failure for one identifier, but client_ip trusts the first client-supplied X-Forwarded-For value. Public tests could choose arbitrary lockout buckets, so an attacker can bypass the per-IP control by rotating this header unless the ingress strips and rewrites it.
Malformed buyer email TEST_invalid@ is accepted with 200 and creates an order. The order's private-link delivery channel can therefore be unusable.
Negative plan price and official price are accepted with 200. This permits invalid catalogue/order totals and is unsafe before real payment is enabled.

minor.issue: Whitespace-only text passes Pydantic min_length, is stripped to an empty string, and is persisted with 200 instead of being rejected. Reproduced twice.

Returns 404 Product not found although the review request explicitly listed this route as working. Seeded/public product slugs are only youtube and spotify; confirm whether domain-subs was a mistaken requested slug.

ui_bugs.issue: A normal click does not leave the panel open: Playwright hover generated by click triggers onMouseEnter (open), then onClick toggles it closed. Hover-only is a working fallback, but the Products button click interaction is broken/inconsistent.
Long buyer emails are clipped by the summary card. At 390px, the card right edge was x=366 while the email content extended to x=465; overflow:hidden hides the remaining address.

issues: UI says checkout runs through Paddle, shows Secure checkout/payment-brand chips, and says secure Paddle checkout even though this build immediately creates simulated orders without collecting payment. Review users can reasonably interpret the order as paid when no payment occurred.

action_items: Use EmailStr (or equivalent robust validation) for buyer_email and credential gmail fields.
Add ge=0 constraints for product and plan prices/official prices; consider requiring at least one valid plan for active products.
Validate message text after stripping and reject an empty result.
Configure trusted proxy handling so arbitrary client X-Forwarded-For cannot select the admin-login rate-limit bucket.
Separate desktop hover and click dropdown behavior so clicking Products reliably opens the panel.
Allow order summary values to wrap or break long tokens/emails on narrow screens.
Make simulated-payment wording explicit and remove real-payment trust claims until Paddle is enabled.
Clarify whether /api/products/domain-subs is truly required or was a typo in the review request.
critical_code_review_comments: CredentialsSubmit/account storage uses plaintext account_password and GET /api/admin/orders returns it to the browser. This is required by the current workflow but creates high-impact credential exposure in MongoDB, API responses, browser memory, and admin UI; encrypt at rest, tightly restrict access, redact logs, and define deletion/retention.

Buyer/admin chat send/load, admin status update, product loading, and admin order loading often swallow request failures without a visible error/retry state. Users can believe an action succeeded when it failed.
ProductPage redirects every product fetch error, including server/network failures, to home, hiding outages as navigation rather than presenting an error state.
Many AdminProducts controls (color/official price/content fields, delivery checkboxes, perk/FAQ add/remove, cancel) lack data-testid, reducing regression-test stability.
server.py is 637 lines and combines auth, catalogue, orders, chat, notifications, startup, and seeding. Split by router/service before additional integrations are added.
Frontend build currently succeeds with React exhaustive-deps warnings in AdminPage.jsx and OrderPage.jsx; resolve or intentionally stabilize dependency objects rather than leaving warnings.

success_rate.backend: 86.7% (26/30 passed; all 4 failures reproduced on retry)
success_rate.frontend: 91.7% (22/24 executed checks passed; 2 UI defects reproduced)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed simulated preplanned/recharge/shared orders and buyer/admin chat messages. Created two unique notify signups. Temporary admin CRUD products were deleted successfully. Orders/messages/signups remain because no delete endpoints exist; one malformed-email order and whitespace-only message were intentionally created to reproduce validation defects.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md exists but contains no usable credentials. Admin tests read ADMIN_PASSWORD from the protected backend environment rather than hardcoding it.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the 30-case public regression suite with pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=... using REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env. Four deterministic failures are intentional defect assertions. Core UI flows are functional. The visual-editor preview injects spans into option elements and causes a console warning; this was environment instrumentation, not application JSX. Desktop Products navigation currently needs hover as a workaround. Retest the 390px long-email summary and normal desktop Products click after fixes.
rca_of_the_issue: Backend validation RCA: OrderCreate.buyer_email and PlanIn price fields use unconstrained str/float types; MessageCreate validates raw length before post-validation .strip(), so invalid values reach persistence. Dropdown RCA: the same state is set true by parent onMouseEnter and then inverted by button onClick during one click. Mobile clipping RCA: .order-summary has overflow:hidden while .order-summary-row is a non-wrapping flex row and the value has no min-width/overflow-wrap rule. Rate-limit RCA: client_ip accepts the first untrusted X-Forwarded-For entry without a trusted-proxy boundary.
